name: Bone Spikes
entriesHtml: Bony protrusions sprout from the creature's skin. The creature gains a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls of unarmed strikes and natural weapon attacks.
description: Bony protrusions sprout from the creature's skin. The creature gains a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls of unarmed strikes and natural weapon attacks.

name: Chromatophores
entriesHtml: The creature's skin gains the camouflaging qualities of a squid. As an action, the creature can make themself invisible for 10 minutes or until they attack, cast a spell, or manifest a power. Once they become invisible in this way, they can't do so again until they finish a long rest.
description: The creature's skin gains the camouflaging qualities of a squid. As an action, the creature can make themself invisible for 10 minutes or until they attack, cast a spell, or manifest a power. Once they become invisible in this way, they can't do so again until they finish a long rest.

name: Redundant Organs
entriesHtml: The creature gains an extra heart, liver, spleen, or other essential organ, granting them advantage on death saving throws.
description: The creature gains an extra heart, liver, spleen, or other essential organ, granting them advantage on death saving throws.

name: Relentless Toughness
entriesHtml: The creature is infused with troll essence. If they are reduced to 0 hit points by damage other than acid or fire damage, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead. Once this effect is triggered, the creature can't benefit from this modification again until they finish a long rest.
description: The creature is infused with troll essence. If they are reduced to 0 hit points by damage other than acid or fire damage, they are reduced to 1 hit point instead. Once this effect is triggered, the creature can't benefit from this modification again until they finish a long rest.

name: Tentacle Arms
entriesHtml: One or more of the creature's arms are replaced with tentacles. The creature's reach is extended by 5 feet.
description: One or more of the creature's arms are replaced with tentacles. The creature's reach is extended by 5 feet.
